title: A Small Network and Its Gradient: One Hidden Layer, Backpropagation Written Out, and a Check by Finite Differences

artifact.note: the smallest network that can bend where a line cannot: two inputs, one hidden layer of tanh units and one output, its weights drawn from a seed; the forward pass; the gradient of half the squared error with respect to every weight, by the chain rule worked backwards through the layer (backpropagation); a check of that gradient against central finite differences; and how many weights the network has
